name: Two Buffalo Cube Days 2026

venue.name: [IronWorkers Banquet Hall](https://www.ironworkershall.com/)
venue.address: 196 Orchard Park Rd, West Seneca, NY 14224

information:
Western New York's first ever 2-day competition! We're excited to continue expanding speedcubing here!

All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

**Saturday events:** 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1
**Sunday events:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb

There will be photography/videography taken at this competition. **By entering this competition, you consent to being photographed and/or filmed for the photographer's use.**
